howItWorks.title: How Voice RAG Works
howItWorks.subtitle: State-of-the-Art Multilingual Indic Information Retrieval
howItWorks.step1.title: 1. Voice Capture & STT
howItWorks.step1.desc: Audio is recorded in standard 16kHz PCM and transcribed with Sarvam AI's saarika:v2 acoustic model for 14 Indian languages.
howItWorks.step2.title: 2. Hybrid Indic Retrieval
howItWorks.step2.desc: Queries are mapped into shared 384-dimensional dense semantic vector space (Qdrant) and indexed BM25 keyword tokens in parallel.
howItWorks.step3.title: 3. RRF Fusion & Cross-Encoder
howItWorks.step3.desc: Candidate passages are blended using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) and reranked using a sub-100ms multilingual cross-encoder.
howItWorks.step4.title: 4. Grounded Synthesis & Guardrails
howItWorks.step4.desc: Answers are synthesized with strict citation grounding, zero hallucination checks, automatic translation, and voice narration.
